text:
anya: dropping a quick read on the workspace create form proto. Proposal: show field-level errors after blur, but aggregate a very short banner on top after submit. Also re: required markers 12 — do we keep asterisks or add the word 'required'?

mike: short answer: both. keep asterisk for compactness, but add an invisible 'required' for screen readers and `aria-required`. users without AT still see compact UI.

kelly: tiny UX point: when inline errors appear, don't push page content too much. prefer errors that occupy the same vertical space as the helper text so the layout doesn't jump.

tom: +1 on non-jumping. Also let's debounce inline validation so we don't flash errors while someone types. 250ms is fine.

aria: Accessibility checklist: 1) `aria-live="polite"` or `role="status"` for non-blocking messages; use `role="alert"`/`aria-live="assertive"` for immediate error announcements when validation occurs on blur or submit. 2) ensure inputs reference errors via `aria-describedby`. 3) announce banner summary explicitly when shown.

anya: implementation detail: show inline onBlur only for fields that have been touched. Show full list-summarized banner only after user hits submit and validation fails. we'll avoid showing all errors on initial mount.

mike: question: should the top banner include links to each field (anchor) so users can jump? on long forms that could be helpful.

kelly: I like anchors on desktop. On mobile the banner should be sticky but compact: "3 errors — review" which expands to a list when tapped. avoid taking up a lot of vertical space.

tom: delete flows: recommend patterns by risk level: low-risk (single item) = inline confirm + undo snackbar; medium = modal with checkbox 'I understand this will delete X' + prominent CTA; high-risk (workspace/org) = typed-confirm.

aria: for typed-confirm modals, ensure focus lands on the input and the modal has `aria-modal="true"`. also include a hidden aria-live that announces result after success/failure. analytics: do NOT log confirmed text; only record success boolean.

anya: copy suggestions for typed confirm modal: header: "Delete workspace?" body: "This action is permanent. Type the workspace name to confirm." primary: "Delete workspace" (destructive). secondary: "Cancel". keep it short.

mike: mobile tradeoff: typed-confirm is cumbersome on small screens. consider a progressive approach: first show a modal with the checkbox + reason, then require typed-confirm only for accounts flagged high-risk.

kelly: visual nits: asterisk color must meet contrast or be paired with text. If we rely on color, add another indicator (icon or text) so color alone isn't the only signal.

tom: tracking: add `ui.form.errors_shown` (count) and `ui.form.validation_strategy` = "inline|summary|hybrid" on submit. for delete: `ui.delete.confirmation_pattern` with values "undo|checkbox|typed". helps correlate with completion/accident rates.

ui-bot: Reminder: export proto to figma/forms/validation/hybrid-2026-03-23

anya: action items: 1) tom to write confirmation pattern doc + metric names (this week). 2) kelly to prototype compact mobile banner and anchor behavior (EOD Tue). 3) aria to add accessibility checklist to the RFC.

aria: small a11y addendum: when the banner appears and we focus it, ensure focus goes to the first actionable element (e.g., a 'go to first error' link) instead of trap-focusing non-interactive text. avoid surprise focus jumps.

mike: can we add a tiny animation for the banner to draw attention without being jarring? subtle slide-down with reduced motion respect.

anya: yes to subtle motion + prefers-reduced-motion. ok I'm going to capture this into a short RFC and include the Figma frames. thanks everyone :white_check_mark:
